configurations.name: next-dev-lan
runtimeArgs: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0); PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin:$PATH" DEV_LAN_HOST=$IP NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://$IP:3101 npm --prefix client run dev -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3100

configurations.name: backend-lan
runtimeArgs: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0); PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin:$PATH" PORT=3101 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3100,http://$IP:3100 npm --prefix backend run dev

configurations.name: expo-web
runtimeArgs: cd mobile-app && PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin:$PATH" CI=1 npx expo start --web --port 8090
